title: USS Paul Hamilton reports an object splashing down

tellings.quote: Uh 24 hours later the US was Paul Hamilton

plain: A researcher named Marik von Rennenkampf, on Jesse Michels' podcast, describes Navy records obtained through the Freedom of Information Act, a US law that lets anyone request government records. He says that in July 2019 off Southern California, about 24 hours after another event, a Navy ship called the USS Paul Hamilton logged an object splashing down into the sea. He offers it as an official paper trail backing up reports of strange objects near Navy ships that summer.
